ios.desc:
Heroes & Merchants is a medieval crafting RPG with heroes, workshops, trading and guild raids. Build your team, gather valuable materials and turn them into weapons, armor and equipment that help you progress.

CRAFT AND BUILD

- Train artisans and improve their workshops.
- Gather resources through missions and dungeons.
- Craft useful equipment and powerful gear.
- Plan your production and grow your crafting economy.

HEROES AND ADVENTURES

- Recruit heroes and choose the right equipment for each challenge.
- Send your team on missions for resources and rewards.
- Explore old-school 3D dungeons and face dangerous enemies.
- Improve your heroes over long-term progression.

GUILDS AND TRADING

- Join a guild and complete cooperative tasks.
- Summon raid bosses and fight together.
- Trade resources and crafted items in the player marketplace.
- Use guild buffs and support your allies.

TACTICAL COMPETITION

- Test your team in strategic 3v3 PvP battles.
- Compete in seasons, events and crafting competitions.
- Choose your skills and prepare your heroes for every opponent.

Optional reward ads are available; there are no forced ads. Build your workshop, equip your heroes and become a legendary artisan and merchant.

quotes.text:
You liked the good old browser games? We also!
That's why we developed HaM. It is a fantasy-crafting MMOG in the style of the old browser games with new interactive content.
HaM is a hobby project of me and my husband. Now we wish that it continues to fill with life and many players enjoy it!
"Heroes and Merchants" is completely free (IOS/Android).

https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.oliverbohnes.hm

https://itunes.apple.com/de/app/heroes-and-merchants/id1442866548?mt=8

What is the game content? 
The game plays in a fantasy world, which was ravaged by rulers of dangerous monsters. The player can recruit heroes and do missions. For this he receives raw materials from which he can produce weapons and armor.

What additional game elements does HaM contain?
Players can team up in guilds, complete guild tasks, summon raid bosses and compete against other players in real-time duels. They can benefit from the guild shop and buffs.
There is the possibility to improve the craftsmen (influence the quality of the goods, selling price, production time).
Heroes have special abilities that can be selected, increased and actively played in duels.
There is also a chat area.

What makes HaM special?
